escapade: The duck's little escapade made mud pies.
小鸭子调皮玩闹，踩出了一个个泥巴饼。
What escapade did the monkey do today?
猴子今天又搞了什么恶作剧呀？
What an escapade, mud on the new rug!
瞧你干的好事，新地毯上全是泥！
escapee: The hamster is a little escapee.
这只仓鼠是个溜出笼的小家伙。
Where is the little escapee now?
那个小逃家选手现在躲哪儿呢？
There's the little escapee under the bed!
小逃家选手就在床底下呢！
essay: I will write an essay about my dog.
我要写一篇关于我家小狗的作文。
你的作文写的是什么呀？
essential: Water is essential for every animal.
水对每只动物来说都必不可少。
Why is sleep essential for kids?
为什么睡觉对孩子们这么重要呢？
How essential water is for us all!
水对我们大家是多么重要呀！
estancia: The horses run on the big estancia.
马儿们在大庄园里奔跑。
What a big estancia with so many cows!
这座大庄园里的牛真多呀！
estate: The old estate has a very big garden.
那座老庄园有一个特别大的花园。
Who lives on that big estate?
谁住在那座大宅院里呢？
How big the estate by the lake is!
estimate: I estimate there are ten cookies in the box.
我估摸着盒子里有十块曲奇。
Can you estimate how many apples we have?
你能估一估我们有多少个苹果吗？
What a close estimate that was!
estuary: Fish from the river swim in the estuary.
河里来的鱼在入海口游来游去。
What animals live in the estuary?
入海口里住着什么动物呢？
How big the estuary looks at sunset!
日落时的入海口看起来好开阔呀！
ethanol: This green car runs on ethanol.
这辆绿色汽车烧的是乙醇。
Wow, farmers make ethanol from corn plants!
哇，农民伯伯能用玉米做出乙醇呢！
ethic: A good work ethic helps at school.
认真做事的好态度在学校很管用。
Do you have a good work ethic?
你做事有认真的好态度吗？
What a good work ethic you have!
ethnicity: Every ethnicity is welcome at our school.
我们学校欢迎每一个民族的孩子。
Do kids of every ethnicity play together?
不同民族的孩子能一起玩吗？
People of every ethnicity are all friends here!
在这里，各民族的人都是好朋友！
etiquette: Good table etiquette makes lunch nice.
好的餐桌礼仪让午饭吃得更加愉快。
What is good etiquette at the table?
餐桌上怎样做才有礼貌呢？
Please use nice etiquette at lunch!
evacuate: We evacuate the building in a fire drill.
消防演习时我们要撤离大楼。
Where do we go when we evacuate?
撤离的时候我们要去哪里呢？
Walk fast when we evacuate, don't run!
撤离时要快快走，不要跑哦！
evacuating: The kids are evacuating the school building.
孩子们正在撤离教学楼。
Who is evacuating the big building?
是谁正在从大楼里撤离呢？
The wave is coming, and the crabs are evacuating!
大浪来啦，螃蟹们都搬家啦！
evacuation: The evacuation drill at school was fast.
学校的疏散演习进行得很快。
What do we take in an evacuation?
撤离的时候我们要带些什么呢？
How fast our evacuation drill was today!
我们今天的疏散演习真迅速呀！
evacuee: The evacuee got a warm meal at the school.
撤离来的朋友在学校吃到了热乎乎的饭。
How can we help the evacuee?
我们能帮撤离来的朋友做点什么呢？
What a warm welcome for the evacuee!
给撤离来的朋友多热情的欢迎呀！
evaporate: Water will evaporate in the hot sun.
Where does the rain go when it evaporates?
雨蒸发以后去哪里了呢？
How fast the water in the hot pan evaporates!
热锅里的水蒸发得真快呀！
evergreen: The evergreen tree is green in winter.
常青树在冬天也是绿的。
Do you see the evergreen by the gate?
你看见大门旁那棵常青树了吗？
How green the big evergreen looks in the snow!
雪地里的大常青树多么翠绿呀！
exact: 现在的准确时间是几点呀？
That is the exact hat I want.
那正是我想要的那顶帽子。
你画得和真的一模一样呀！
exaggerated: That fish story was a little exaggerated.
那个钓鱼的故事有点夸张啦。
Was that story about the big fish exaggerated?
那个关于大鱼的故事是不是夸张了呀？
How exaggerated that tall story was!
那个夸张的故事编得也太离谱啦！
exasperated: Mother got exasperated at all the noise.
吵吵闹闹的，妈妈都有点招架不住了。
Why does Father look so exasperated?
Don't get exasperated with your little brother!
别被小弟弟气得没办法啦！
excavate: The team will excavate old tools in the dirt.
考古队要从土里挖出古老的工具。
What did they excavate near the old gate?
他们在旧城门附近挖出了什么呀？
Wow, look what they excavate from the sand!
哇，快看他们从沙子里挖出了什么！
excavation: The excavation is at the old city gate.
发掘现场就在旧城门那儿。
What was found at the excavation?
在发掘现场找到了什么呀？
The excavation goes down, down, down!
这个发掘坑好深呀，一直往下挖呢！
exceed: The big fish can exceed two feet long.
这种大鱼能长到超过两英尺长。
Did the snake exceed three feet?
那条蛇超过三英尺了吗？
Wow, this snowman will exceed the fence!
哇，这个雪人快要高过栅栏啦！
excel: I excel at art in school.
我在学校的美术方面很出色。
Does your sister excel at tennis?
你的姐姐网球打得特别厉害吗？
How you excel at the high jump!
exceptional: 她是个特别出色的游泳好手。
What made this an exceptional day?
什么事让今天变得这么特别呀？
executive: The executive works in a tall city building.
那位主管在一栋高高的城市大楼里上班。
What does the executive do at work?
主管上班都做些什么呢？
The executive takes the fast train to work!
主管坐特别快的火车去上班！
exhale: Run fast, then stop and exhale.
快跑一阵，然后停下呼气。
I exhale warm air in the cold snow.
冷冷的雪天里，我呼出暖暖的气。
When you exhale, where does the air go?
你呼气的时候，空气去哪儿了呢？
